snapshots.publicationNotes: Starter snapshot shipped with the repository. Interface and formula test data only. Replace it with extracted statements before publishing any company-specific conclusion.

company.name: Asian Paints
company.researchNotes:
This snapshot exists to exercise the model, the editor and the publication pipeline. The figures are invented placeholders chosen to reconcile with each other, not numbers read off an annual report, and no valuation conclusion should be drawn from them.

To turn this into real research: extract the consolidated statements for 5 years, enter each figure with its report, page and unit, set every reported line to verified, re-derive the cost of capital with dated market inputs, then set the data status to verified and publish.

bull.label: Bull
bull.notes: Faster volume growth with premium mix holding, a lower discount rate, and terminal growth closer to nominal economic growth.

base.label: Base
base.notes: The published assumption set, with growth tapering from 8% to 6% across the forecast.

bear.label: Bear
bear.notes: Competitive entry compresses pricing, input costs stay elevated, and the market demands a higher return.
